$comment: Deliberate, reviewed exceptions to the cross-stack typography gate (scripts/check-typography-parity.mjs). Every entry must state WHY the literal cannot use a Typography token. Keep this list short and shrinking — it is a debt ledger, not a dumping ground.

qtFontSizeLiterals.reason: Stepper caret glyph (▴/▾) standing in for a React <svg class="size-2.5">. It is an icon, not a text role, and has no React font-size counterpart.
Loading spinner glyph (◐) drawn as a Text inside the switch thumb — an icon stand-in, not a text role.
FontMetrics badge measurement used only to compute content width; never painted. The floor is a guard against negative deltas, not a type size.
Dense-mode slider label: 8/9px sub-nano jitter below the scale floor (Typography.sizeNano = 9). Pending a design call on whether dense mode should snap to 9.
Material Symbols variable font / Segoe Fluent glyph renderer dynamic size dynamically parameterized by component size prop (e.g. 14, 16, 20, 24), not static typography roles.
